name: filter_math_api
description: Math API calls on a doc value: log, sqrt and pow. The whitelisted Math methods are direct JVM calls, so this measures how much of the cost is the call boundary rather than the maths.

script.source: double d = Math.log(1 + doc['content_length'].value) * Math.sqrt(2.0) + Math.pow(1.5, 3); return d >= 0;
